newsitem.title: UK: Abbey, NatWest up on renewed merger reports.
newsitem.headline: Abbey, NatWest up on renewed merger reports.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc opened up 9.5 pence on Friday amid renewed reports of a merger between the UK bank and its larger rival National Westminster Bank Plc.
"There will be consolidation in the sector, whether that will involve anyone bidding for Abbey remains to be seen," the equities head of one European firm said.
Abbey shares were up 10 pence at 853.5 pence at 0735 GMT, while NatWest shares were up 10.5 pence at 747.5 pence at the same time.

UK newspapers on Friday suggested a resumption of merger talks between the two banks. Both have so far denied they have considered merging following a Sunday newspaper report which said a NatWest approach to Abbey had been rejected by the former building society.
An Abbey National spokesman declined to comment on the renewed speculation. But a senior Abbey executive has said the bank does talk to other institutions "from time to time".
NatWest was not immediately available for comment.
